title: Extraction
subtitle: Extract math tasks from various sources
heroDescription: Transform any YouTube tutorial, PDF book, whiteboard photo or text into digital tasks.
urlInputPlaceholder: Paste one or more links — YouTube video OR a web page with tasks (e.g. a site with exams). Each link on a new line. (Bulk Mode - inspired by ReClip)
transcriptPlaceholder: Optional: Paste a manual transcript here if the system fails to download it...
scraperTitle: Built-in Web & YouTube Scraper (Free / No ScraperAPI extension needed)
scraperDescription: The same field above accepts any link — not just YouTube. Paste a link from any web page with tasks (e.g. a site with exams in Cyrillic) and the content is automatically extracted, including math formulas.
howItWorks1: No need for external Edge/Chrome tools or $50 ScraperAPI subscriptions.
howItWorks2: YouTube link → we extract the hidden transcript (CC) for free.
howItWorks3: Link to a regular web page → we extract the text and math expressions (MathJax/KaTeX) from the page.
howItWorks4: Open the Advanced Parameters below for fine-tuning (inspired by the original extension).
processingMethod1: Choose the desired nuance from the new Interpretative Level (Faithful, Clean, Reformulate, Examples, Summary).
processingMethod2: The system will automatically process all math expressions into LaTeX format.
processingMethod3: Extracted results can then be exported to Markdown, LaTeX, TXT or Word/PDF formats.
fileClickOrDrag: Click or drag & drop PDF / Word (.docx) / Video / Image
fileSupportNote: Support for old OCR books, handwriting and Word documents with embedded formulas
textInputPlaceholder: Write or paste a raw transcript (e.g. from WayinVideo or YouTube Summary) here...
proTipText: If the YouTube scraper doesn't work or the video has no subtitles, use Chrome extensions like WayinVideo or YouTube Summary with AI. Copy the transcript from there in English and paste it here. The system will automatically translate and format it!
interpretativeLevelTooltip: Determines how much the AI model will modify the original content.
instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Focus only on algebra, ignore geometry...
bulkModeActive: Bulk Mode Activated: Tasks will be extracted from {{count}} links sequentially!
errorTranscriptTitle: We cannot load the transcript from this video
emptyStateDescription: Don't waste time transcribing. Enter a YouTube link or attach a photo of an assigned task and let MathDigitizer handle the processing.
featureVideoDesc: We pull transcripts directly from YouTube and create a textual overview of the lecture.
featureOcrDesc: We scan PDFs/images and convert them into clean LaTeX code along with a solving system.
featureQuizDesc: From every extraction, you can create a Kahoot quiz or MakedoTest with one click.
